```yaml
name: Build Container

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        id: buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v2
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        run: |
          docker build --platform linux/amd64 -t ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/codenameone-build:${{ github.sha }} .
          docker push ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/codenameone-build:${{ github.sha }}
```

```yaml
name: Calculate Docker Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  calculate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Calculate Docker image
        id: calculate
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
        with:
          use-custom-docker-registry: true
          docker-image-name: codenameone-build
          docker-build-dir: .ci/container
          docker-build-script: Dockerfile
          docker-build-timeout-minutes: 10
          custom-tag-prefix: ${GITHUB_SHA}
          working-directory: .
          docker-registry: ghcr.io
          always-rebuild: false
          push: true
          force-push: false
          repo-name: ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}
          ci-docker-hash: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Download Docker image
        id: download
        uses: ishworkh/container-image-artifact-download@v2.1.0
        with:
          image: ${{ steps.calculate.outputs.docker-image }}
          container_engine: docker
          repository: ghcr.io
          workflow: ${{ github.workflow }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          download_tmp_dir: /tmp
          workflow_conclusion: success
          commit_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          workflow_event: ${{ github.event_name }}
          workflow_run_id: ${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Use downloaded Docker image
        uses: addnab/docker-run-action@v3
        with:
          image: ${{ steps.download.outputs.download_path }}
          run: ./scripts/build.sh
```

name: Scan Docker Image

  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Pull Docker image
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-image: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/codenameone-build:${{ github.sha }}
          docker-registry: ghcr.io

      - name: Scan Docker image
        uses: anchore/scan-action@1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e
        with:
          image: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/codenameone-build:${{ github.sha }}
          path: /
          fail-build: true
          output-format: json
          output-file: report.json
          severity-cutoff: high
          only-fixed: true
          add-cpes-if-none: true
          by-cve: false
          grype-version: latest
          vex: false
          cache-db: true
